## Required Courses

---

Choose one capstone course:

- THTR 395m Drama as Human Relations Units: 4
- THTR 403 The Performing Arts Units: 4
- THTR 405m Performing Identities Units: 4

### Plus four to six courses (16 units) from the following list

---

The additional 16 units must be completed outside of the student’s school.
At least 4 units must be selected from each school.

notes.text: The minor in performing arts provides an interdisciplinary inquiry into the nature and aesthetics of the performing arts. It combines the disciplines of cinematic arts, dance, music and theatre. The minor is a unique course of study that looks at how the performing arts contribute to a culturally literate society. The minor in performing arts studies is a 20-unit program.
